text:
Three of the main uses of the hand are grasping and holding objects, fine manipulation (writing, buttoning, using tools), and tactile sensing (feeling texture, shape, and temperature). The "touch and feel" part of the team note matches tactile sensing, but "stroke" isn't a standard category, so I'd leave it out. Sources differ on the five uses, and some list gesturing/communication or weight-bearing instead.

CONFIDENCE: 75
